0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, 8th in the West, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game winning streak, 10th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (day-to-day, hip bruise, game-time decision), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise) and Trey Murphy III (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision). The teams have not met yet this season, but Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
